title_zh: 修改模拟审判日志中的道德判断

scenario.label_zh: 区分模拟审判的证据与道德评价
scenario.goal_zh: 依据虚构课堂材料区分证据判断和道德评价，约定重写学习日志的结论

context_zh: 美国公民课上，艾丽西亚与老师讨论完全虚构的模拟审判任务；对话不提供法律意见。
author: author-phase08-b

sentences.speaker: Alicia
sentences.text: Our jury couldn't agree about the witness. Does that mean the exercise failed?

sentences.speaker: Mr Brooks
sentences.text: No. The task was to explain which evidence you trusted, not to reach a quick decision.

sentences.speaker: Alicia
sentences.text: In my journal, I said the witness was a bad person because he changed his story.

sentences.speaker: Mr Brooks
sentences.text: Can the evidence justify that judgment? A changed story may need explaining, but it doesn't tell us everything about a person.

sentences.speaker: Alicia
sentences.text: So I've turned a question about accuracy into a moral judgment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Brooks
sentences.text: Exactly. We can discuss justice without pretending that one classroom case gives us all the answers.

sentences.speaker: Alicia
sentences.text: I'll replace the last paragraph with the two contradictions we noticed and the questions we'd still need answered.

sentences.speaker: Mr Brooks
sentences.text: That will show your reasoning much more clearly.
